observations: Named root exports, version and __all__ literals; retain normal package initialization and every selected import.
MetaStyle.__getattr__ is a finite raise-only hook bound to InvalidStyle.
Style class body constructs Utilities and populates class-local vars() from the literal STYLES table; no dunder palette keys were found.
MetaBack.__getattr__ is a finite raise-only hook bound to InvalidColor.
Back class body generates attributes from the literal palette; RGB methods use Utilities.
Config has TTY_AWARE=True and WIN_VTERM_MODE=None. Colored initialization creates Hex and Utilities and checks hex only for a # name.

The module calls enable_windows_terminal_mode. Its platform.system windows branch accesses ctypes windll/kernel32 GetStdHandle, GetConsoleMode and SetConsoleMode. The original conditional native branch is retained, not executed in this review.
enabled() reads FORCE_COLOR, NO_COLOR and isatty; set_tty_aware changes Config only when explicitly called.
foreground_rgb/background_rgb call Utilities.is_percentage and form RGB ANSI strings without the enabled() gate. This is a source observation, not a runtime witness.
Ordinary control classes and methods with standard-library typing annotations; methods outside cprint are retained in the closed import set.
Ordinary class methods for hexadecimal/ANSI conversion; no module-level target invocation found.
cprint constructs attribute/reset fragments and resolves foreground/background before printing; it writes stdout and returns None rather than returning a formatted string.
resolve_foreground/resolve_background destructure a nonempty RGB tuple inside target code. All eight proposed tuples are nonempty.
force_color is not a target parameter; forwarding it through kwargs reaches print and would create an unrelated TypeError.
Four direct Exception subclasses; their initializers call super().__init__(message). These definitions bind the finite metaclass exceptions.
MetaFore.__getattr__ is a finite raise-only hook bound to InvalidColor.
Fore class body generates attributes from the literal palette, analogous to Back.
Hex conversion methods include loops over the fixed literal color table; no module-level target call found.
Single constants class with docstring/annotated assignments; ESC and END literals, five f-strings referencing earlier ESC, and literal dictionaries.
Dictionary sizes observed by AST/literal inspection: CONTROLS=12, STYLES=16, COLORTERM=6, COLORS=256, HEX_COLORS=256. No dunder palette keys found; no target eval/exec/import used.
Utilities initialization reads literal Library tables and COLORTERM through set_colorterm; the default call does not write environment state.
An explicitly nonempty set_colorterm argument can write the environment, but the mapped calls do not supply it.
is_percentage destructures three values, supports percentage strings and clamps converted channels with max(0, min(255, ...)); this mapping is restricted to integer tuples.
